snippet.title: The Night AC Milan Refused to Play
snippet.description:
March 20, 1991. Marseille vs AC Milan. A European Cup quarter-final that would become one of the most controversial nights in football history.

AC Milan had conquered Europe twice in a row. With legends like Ruud Gullit, Marco van Basten, Frank Rijkaard and Franco Baresi, they seemed unstoppable.

But at the Stade Vélodrome, everything changed.

A floodlight failure, a dramatic walkout, and a decision that would cost Milan their place in Europe.

Why did AC Milan refuse to continue playing? Who made the decision? And how did one night in Marseille change the course of European football?

This documentary explores the full story — from the rise of Berlusconi's Milan to the 1991 controversy, UEFA's punishment, and the two clubs' unforgettable reunion in the 1993 Champions League final.

snippet.title: The Luis Figo Transfer Scandal Nobody Talks About
snippet.description:
Before the infamous Barcelona–Real Madrid transfer, Luís Figo was already at the center of another incredible football scandal.

In 1995, Juventus and Parma both believed they had secured one of Portugal's brightest young talents.

Two Italian giants. Two conflicting deals. One player.

How did it happen? Who was telling the truth? And how did Figo end up at FC Barcelona instead?

This is the forgotten transfer scandal that almost changed football history.
